faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NHM Thiruvananthapuram Public Relations Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Public Relations Officer posts is 05 September 2026. It is advisable to submit your application well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Public Relations Officer post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Public Relations Officer position in the National Health Mission Thiruvananthapuram.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required qualification for the Public Relations Officer role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MSW, MBA, or MHA degree along with two years of post-qualification experience to be eligible for the Public Relations Officer post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to this position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 40 years as of 01 August 2026. Age relaxation will be provided as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Public Relations Officer position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 24,000/- per month for the Public Relations Officer role.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for the NHM Thiruvananthapuram recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee for General/OBC and SC/ST categories is Rs. 350/-. This fee needs to be paid online during the application process.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the NHM Thiruvananthapuram Public Relations Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Written Test, followed by an Interview, and finally Document Verification for the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: This recruitment is for contract-based positions. The job type is specified as Contractual.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF and the online application link can be found in the "Important Links" section of this article. You can also visit the official websites mentioned.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required for the application?
faq.answer: Candidates will need to upload required documents such as a photograph, signature, and relevant educational and experience certificates in the prescribed format during the online application process.
